notes:
Seabyss Beta 0.1.7-beta.56

- Earned currency becomes available after durable acceptance while PlayFab synchronization continues in the background.
- Improved profile save scheduling and recovery of pending rewards across reconnects and server restarts.
- Added Elite Ships 4-7, Elite portraits 1-7, and Idle animations for six sea monsters.
- Added sharp reload/repair indicators and reload countdown; attacks resume when an engaged target returns to range.
- Updated Login/Profile presentation, compact panels and World Map; main windows now cover ordinary HUD elements.
- Captains: 1,250 Gold or Diamonds. Market ship designs: 10,000 Diamonds (9,000 Premium).
- Plates and powders: 100 units for 100 Diamonds (90 Premium).
- World Boss Siren's Tears: 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 / 13 by tier, retaining the existing last-hit rule.
- Retired the MONEY promo code.

Windows x64. Install or update through Seabyss Launcher 0.1.9.
